lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.

dishes.name: Berry honey yoghurt pot
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, oats, berries and honey
dishes.method: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl, add the oats and berries, then finish with the honey.
dishes.why: The yoghurt makes this quick breakfast substantial, while seasonal berries keep it fresh.

dishes.name: Lemony chicken bulgur bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, bulgur, roasted vegetables, cucumber and yoghurt
dishes.method: Put one freshly cooked portion each of chicken, bulgur and roasted vegetables in a bowl. Add sliced cucumber and yoghurt, then squeeze over the lemon.
dishes.why: The first cooking session immediately supplies a proper lunch rather than creating boxes with no meal attached.

dishes.name: Golden chicken supper
dishes.title: Chicken, warm bulgur, roasted vegetables and feta
dishes.method: Build the plate with one still-warm portion each of chicken, bulgur and roasted vegetables. Crumble over the feta and squeeze over the lemon; the warm bulgur is a warm anchor.
dishes.why: Warm bulgur and roasted summer vegetables make dinner satisfying without turning an August evening into a heavy cooking project.

dishes.name: Tomato cottage crunch
dishes.title: Cottage cheese, rye crispbread and tomato
dishes.method: Spoon the cottage cheese onto the crispbreads and top with sliced tomato and basil.
dishes.why: Cottage cheese provides the anchor for a breakfast that needs no morning cooking.

dishes.name: Smoky bean garden pitta
dishes.title: Butter beans, roasted vegetables, rocket and wholemeal pitta
dishes.method: Fill the pitta with one freshly cooked portion of smoky butter beans, one portion of roasted vegetables and the rocket.
dishes.why: Butter beans turn the remaining roasted vegetables into a new lunch rather than a repeat of Wednesday's chicken bowl.

dishes.name: Herby meatball couscous
dishes.title: Turkey meatballs, warm couscous, cucumber and yoghurt
dishes.method: Put one freshly cooked portion of meatballs and one portion of couscous on the plate. Add sliced cucumber, yoghurt and torn mint; the couscous is a warm anchor.
dishes.why: The second short cooking session gives dinner a warm anchor and also prepares Friday's meals.

dishes.name: Peach oat yoghurt bowl
dishes.title: Greek yoghurt, peach, oats and pumpkin seeds
dishes.method: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and top with sliced peach, oats and pumpkin seeds.
dishes.why: This uses the breakfast staples already in the basket while making seasonal fruit the main flavour.

dishes.name: Meatball tomato pocket
dishes.title: Turkey meatballs, tomato, rocket and yoghurt pitta
dishes.method: Halve the cold meatballs and tuck them into the pitta with sliced tomato, rocket and yoghurt.
dishes.why: Yesterday's meatballs become a portable fresh lunch instead of repeating the couscous plate.

dishes.name: Smoky bean couscous bowl
dishes.title: Warm butter beans, spinach, tomatoes and couscous
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of smoky butter beans and one portion of couscous until piping hot, then serve together. The pan-warmed couscous is a warm anchor.
dishes.why: The final dinner uses the second session completely and keeps the evening plate warm without requiring another cooking session.

preparations.title: Lemon and paprika chicken thighs
preparations.method: Heat the oven to 220°C, or 200°C fan. Coat the chicken with the oil, lemon juice, crushed garlic, paprika, salt and pepper. Roast for 25 minutes until browned and cooked through, then divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Fluffy bulgur wheat
preparations.method: Put the bulgur, water and salt in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Take off the heat, stand for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork. Divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Roasted courgettes, peppers and onion
preparations.method: Cut the courgettes, peppers and onion into bite-sized pieces. Toss with the oil, oregano, salt and pepper, spread on a tray and roast at 220°C, or 200°C fan, for 25 minutes. Divide into three portions.

preparations.title: Smoky butter beans with spinach
preparations.method: Chop the tomatoes. Warm the oil in a saucepan and cook the crushed garlic and paprika for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes, beans, water, salt and pepper; simmer for 12 minutes. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then divide into two portions.

preparations.title: Herby turkey meatballs
preparations.method: Heat the oven to 220°C, or 200°C fan. Mix the turkey, oats, egg, crushed garlic, chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Shape into 10 meatballs, coat with the oil and bake for 18 minutes until browned and cooked through. Divide into two portions of five.

preparations.title: Lemon-free fluffy couscous
preparations.method: Put the couscous and salt in a heatproof bowl. Pour over the boiling water, cover and leave for 8 minutes. Fluff thoroughly with a fork and divide into two portions.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven first. Season the chicken, chop and dress the vegetables, then put both trays in together. Start the bulgur while they roast. Fluff the bulgur, check the chicken is cooked, then divide all three preparations into their stated portions; keep today's food warm and refrigerate Thursday's vegetable portion promptly.

Heat the oven and mix and shape the meatballs first, then put them in to bake. Start the smoky beans on the hob. Pour boiling water over the couscous while the beans simmer and the meatballs bake. Fluff the couscous, finish the beans with spinach, then divide everything into two portions; refrigerate Friday's portions promptly.
